objects.description: Opaque 64-bit unsigned identifier used by H3 to represent objects such as cells, directed edges, and vertices.
32-bit result code type returned by H3 API functions. Values are from the H3ErrorCodes enum.

objects.definition:
typedef enum {
    E_SUCCESS = 0,  // Success (no error)
    E_FAILED = 1,   // The operation failed but a more specific error is not
                    // available
    E_DOMAIN = 2,   // Argument was outside the acceptable range (when a more
                    // specific error code is not available)
    E_LATLNG_DOMAIN = 3,  // Latitude or longitude arguments were outside the
                          // acceptable range
    E_RES_DOMAIN = 4,    // Resolution argument was outside the acceptable range
    E_CELL_INVALID = 5,  // `H3Index` cell argument was not valid
    E_DIR_EDGE_INVALID = 6,  // `H3Index` directed edge argument was not valid
    E_UNDIR_EDGE_INVALID =
        7,                 // `H3Index` undirected edge argument was not valid
    E_VERTEX_INVALID = 8,  // `H3Index` vertex argument was not valid
    E_PENTAGON = 9,  // Pentagon distortion was encountered which the algorithm
                     // could not handle
    E_DUPLICATE_INPUT = 10,  // Duplicate input was encountered in the arguments
                             // and the algorithm could not handle it
    E_NOT_NEIGHBORS = 11,    // `H3Index` cell arguments were not neighbors
    E_RES_MISMATCH =
        12,  // `H3Index` cell arguments had incompatible resolutions
    E_MEMORY_ALLOC = 13,   // Necessary memory allocation failed
    E_MEMORY_BOUNDS = 14,  // Bounds of provided memory were not large enough

    E_OPTION_INVALID = 15,  // Mode or flags argument was not valid
    E_INDEX_INVALID = 16,   // `H3Index` argument was not valid
    E_BASE_CELL_DOMAIN =
        17,                // Base cell number was outside of acceptable range
    E_DIGIT_DOMAIN = 18,   // Child digits invalid
    E_DELETED_DIGIT = 19,  // Deleted subsequence indicates invalid index

    // Sentinel value; not a real error. One past the last valid code.
    H3_ERROR_END
} H3ErrorCodes;
objects.description: Enumeration of concrete H3 error codes corresponding to H3Error values.
Latitude/longitude pair in radians. Used as input/output for geographic conversions and distances.
Fixed-capacity polygonal boundary for a single H3 cell, storing up to MAX_CELL_BNDRY_VERTS vertices in CCW order.
Dynamically-allocated loop of vertices forming a closed ring. Used for polygon exteriors and holes.
Polygon with one exterior geoloop and zero or more interior hole loops. Memory for holes and their verts is managed by the caller unless otherwise documented.
Collection of polygons. Caller manages memory for the polygons array and nested loops.
Enum for polygon fill containment semantics used with polygonToCellsExperimental flags.
Node in a singly linked list of LatLng vertices, used in linked polygon representations. Ownership is by the containing LinkedGeoLoop.
Linked-list ring (loop) composed of LinkedLatLng nodes; multiple loops can be chained via next. Owned by a LinkedGeoPolygon.
Linked-list polygon container holding a chain of LinkedGeoLoop rings, and optionally chained to additional polygons via next.
Discrete axial-like IJ coordinates on the H3 hex grid, spaced at 120 degrees. Used for local coordinate transforms.

functions.name: describeH3Error
functions.description: Converts an H3Error code to a human-readable description string. Useful for logging and diagnostics.
requirements: err may be any value of H3ErrorCodes; non-enumerated values may return a generic/unknown description.
The returned pointer refers to an internal static string; do not free or modify.

functions.name: latLngToCell
functions.signature: H3Error latLngToCell(const LatLng *g, int res, H3Index *out)
functions.description: Finds the H3 index of the cell at resolution res containing the given lat/lng coordinate (in radians).
requirements: g must point to a valid LatLng in radians.
res must be within the library’s supported resolution range (otherwise E_RES_DOMAIN).
out must point to writable memory for one H3Index.
On invalid input (e.g., out-of-range latitude/longitude) an error is returned; caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: cellToLatLng
functions.description: Returns the center point of the H3 cell as a LatLng (in radians).
requirements: h3 must be a valid H3 cell index (otherwise E_CELL_INVALID/E_INDEX_INVALID).
g must point to writable memory for one LatLng.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: cellToBoundary
functions.description: Computes the boundary of the H3 cell as a polygon (counter-clockwise vertex order, in radians).
requirements: h3 must be a valid H3 cell index.
gp must point to writable memory for one CellBoundary (the function sets numVerts and verts).
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: maxGridDiskSize
functions.description: Computes the maximum number of cells in a k-ring (disk) neighborhood, used for sizing buffers for gridDisk variants.
requirements: k must be a non-negative integer (domain errors on invalid).
out must point to writable memory for one int64_t.
Caller must check the H3Error return value before using out.

functions.name: gridDiskUnsafe
functions.signature: H3Error gridDiskUnsafe(H3Index origin, int k, H3Index *out)
functions.description: Returns neighbors within k hex rings around origin, assuming no pentagons; does not protect against pentagon distortion cases.
requirements: origin must be a valid H3 cell index.
k must be non-negative.
out must reference a buffer large enough to hold the count from maxGridDiskSize(k).
Caller must check the H3Error return value.
Unsafe variant assumes no pentagons; use safe variants if pentagons may be present.

functions.name: gridDiskDistancesUnsafe
functions.signature: H3Error gridDiskDistancesUnsafe(H3Index origin, int k, H3Index *out, int *distances)
functions.description: Like gridDiskUnsafe but also returns the grid distance from origin for each output cell.
requirements: origin must be a valid H3 cell index.
k must be non-negative.
out must reference a buffer large enough for maxGridDiskSize(k) H3Index values.
distances must reference a buffer of at least the same length as out.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.
Unsafe variant assumes no pentagons.

functions.name: gridDiskDistancesSafe
functions.signature: H3Error gridDiskDistancesSafe(H3Index origin, int k, H3Index *out, int *distances)
functions.description: Returns neighbors within k rings and their grid distances, with handling for pentagons/safe traversal.
requirements: origin must be a valid H3 cell index.
k must be non-negative.
out must reference a buffer large enough to hold maxGridDiskSize(k) elements.
distances must reference a buffer of at least the same length as out.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: gridDisksUnsafe
functions.signature: H3Error gridDisksUnsafe(H3Index *h3Set, int length, int k, H3Index *out)
functions.description: For each input cell, computes neighbors within k rings and returns results grouped by ring per input; assumes no pentagons.
requirements: h3Set must point to an array of length elements containing valid H3 cell indexes.
length must be non-negative and match the array size.
k must be non-negative.
out must be large enough to hold length * maxGridDiskSize(k) results (layout is by ring as per library conventions).
Caller must check the H3Error return value.
Unsafe variant assumes no pentagons.

functions.name: gridDisk
functions.signature: H3Error gridDisk(H3Index origin, int k, H3Index *out)
functions.description: Returns neighbors within k rings around origin, handling pentagons and distortion cases.
requirements: origin must be a valid H3 cell index.
k must be non-negative.
out must reference a buffer large enough for maxGridDiskSize(k) elements.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: gridDiskDistances
functions.signature: H3Error gridDiskDistances(H3Index origin, int k, H3Index *out, int *distances)
functions.description: Returns neighbors within k rings and their grid distances from origin, handling pentagons.
requirements: origin must be a valid H3 cell index.
k must be non-negative.
out must reference a buffer large enough for maxGridDiskSize(k) elements.
distances must reference a buffer of at least the same length as out.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: maxGridRingSize
functions.description: Computes the maximum number of cells in a hollow k-ring (exact ring at distance k).
requirements: k must be a non-negative integer.
out must point to writable memory for one int64_t.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: gridRingUnsafe
functions.signature: H3Error gridRingUnsafe(H3Index origin, int k, H3Index *out)
functions.description: Computes the hollow ring of cells at grid distance k from origin, assuming no pentagons.
requirements: origin must be a valid H3 cell index.
k must be non-negative.
out must have capacity for the count given by maxGridRingSize(k).
Caller must check the H3Error return value.
Unsafe variant assumes no pentagons.

functions.name: gridRing
functions.signature: H3Error gridRing(H3Index origin, int k, H3Index *out)
functions.description: Computes the hollow ring of cells at grid distance k from origin, handling pentagons.
requirements: origin must be a valid H3 cell index.
k must be non-negative.
out must have capacity for the count given by maxGridRingSize(k).
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: maxPolygonToCellsSize
functions.signature: H3Error maxPolygonToCellsSize(const GeoPolygon *geoPolygon, int res, uint32_t flags, int64_t *out)
functions.description: Returns an upper bound on the number of cells that polygonToCells could produce for the given GeoPolygon, resolution, and flags.
requirements: geoPolygon must point to a valid GeoPolygon with correctly allocated loops/holes and vertex counts.
res must be within the supported resolution range.
flags controls containment mode; use values compatible with ContainmentMode (e.g., CONTAINMENT_CENTER/CONTAINMENT_FULL/etc.).
out must point to writable memory for one int64_t.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: polygonToCells
functions.signature: H3Error polygonToCells(const GeoPolygon *geoPolygon, int res, uint32_t flags, H3Index *out)
functions.description: Fills out with all H3 cells at resolution res that satisfy the containment mode specified by flags for the given polygon.
requirements: geoPolygon must be valid with vertices in radians and properly allocated arrays.
res must be within the supported range.
flags must specify a valid containment selection (see ContainmentMode).
out must be a buffer at least as large as the value indicated by maxPolygonToCellsSize for the same inputs.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: maxPolygonToCellsSizeExperimental
functions.signature: H3Error maxPolygonToCellsSizeExperimental(const GeoPolygon *polygon, int res, uint32_t flags, int64_t *out)
functions.description: Experimental API: Returns an upper bound on the number of cells that polygonToCellsExperimental may output.
requirements: polygon must be a valid GeoPolygon.
res must be within the supported range.
flags is a bit field including containment modes (see ContainmentMode); invalid modes may yield E_OPTION_INVALID.
out must point to writable memory for one int64_t.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.
API is experimental and may change in minor versions.

functions.name: polygonToCellsExperimental
functions.signature: H3Error polygonToCellsExperimental(const GeoPolygon *polygon, int res, uint32_t flags, int64_t size, H3Index *out)
functions.description: Experimental API: Fills out with cells covering/intersecting the polygon according to flags; caller provides explicit output size.
requirements: polygon must be a valid GeoPolygon.
res must be within the supported range.
flags must use valid containment options (see ContainmentMode).
size must be at least the bound returned by maxPolygonToCellsSizeExperimental for the same inputs to avoid E_MEMORY_BOUNDS.
out must point to a buffer of at least size H3Index elements.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.
API is experimental and may change in minor versions.

functions.name: cellsToLinkedMultiPolygon
functions.signature: H3Error cellsToLinkedMultiPolygon(const H3Index *h3Set, const int numHexes, LinkedGeoPolygon *out)
functions.description: Constructs a linked polygon representation describing the outlines of a contiguous set of cells.
requirements: h3Set must point to an array of numHexes valid H3 cell indexes.
numHexes must be non-negative and reflect the array length.
out must point to an uninitialized LinkedGeoPolygon to be filled; the caller must later free via destroyLinkedMultiPolygon.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: destroyLinkedMultiPolygon
functions.description: Frees all memory allocated for a LinkedGeoPolygon created by cellsToLinkedMultiPolygon.
requirements: polygon must be either NULL or a LinkedGeoPolygon previously allocated by cellsToLinkedMultiPolygon (safe to pass to free routine).
Must be called to avoid memory leaks after cellsToLinkedMultiPolygon.

functions.name: degsToRads
functions.description: Converts degrees to radians.
requirements: Input is interpreted as degrees; no special range requirements.

functions.name: radsToDegs
functions.description: Converts radians to degrees.
requirements: Input is interpreted as radians; no special range requirements.

functions.name: greatCircleDistanceRads
functions.description: Computes the great-circle distance between two coordinates, returning radians.
requirements: a and b must point to valid LatLngs in radians.

functions.name: greatCircleDistanceKm
functions.description: Computes the great-circle distance between two coordinates, returning kilometers.
requirements: a and b must point to valid LatLngs in radians.

functions.name: greatCircleDistanceM
functions.description: Computes the great-circle distance between two coordinates, returning meters.
requirements: a and b must point to valid LatLngs in radians.

functions.name: getHexagonAreaAvgKm2
functions.description: Returns the average hexagon cell area (excluding pentagons) at resolution res in square kilometers.
requirements: res must be within the supported resolution range.
out must point to writable memory for one double.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: getHexagonAreaAvgM2
functions.description: Returns the average hexagon cell area (excluding pentagons) at resolution res in square meters.
requirements: res must be within the supported resolution range.
out must point to writable memory for one double.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: cellAreaRads2
functions.description: Returns the exact area of a specific cell (hexagon or pentagon) in square radians.
requirements: h must be a valid H3 cell index.
out must point to writable memory for one double.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: cellAreaKm2
functions.description: Returns the exact area of a specific cell (hexagon or pentagon) in square kilometers.
requirements: h must be a valid H3 cell index.
out must point to writable memory for one double.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: cellAreaM2
functions.description: Returns the exact area of a specific cell (hexagon or pentagon) in square meters.
requirements: h must be a valid H3 cell index.
out must point to writable memory for one double.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: getHexagonEdgeLengthAvgKm
functions.description: Returns the average hexagon edge length (excluding pentagons) at resolution res in kilometers.
requirements: res must be within the supported resolution range.
out must point to writable memory for one double.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: getHexagonEdgeLengthAvgM
functions.description: Returns the average hexagon edge length (excluding pentagons) at resolution res in meters.
requirements: res must be within the supported resolution range.
out must point to writable memory for one double.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: edgeLengthRads
functions.description: Returns the exact length of a specific directed edge in radians.
requirements: edge must be a valid H3 directed edge index (otherwise E_DIR_EDGE_INVALID/E_INDEX_INVALID).
length must point to writable memory for one double.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: edgeLengthKm
functions.description: Returns the exact length of a specific directed edge in kilometers.
requirements: edge must be a valid H3 directed edge index.
length must point to writable memory for one double.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: edgeLengthM
functions.description: Returns the exact length of a specific directed edge in meters.
requirements: edge must be a valid H3 directed edge index.
length must point to writable memory for one double.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: getNumCells
functions.description: Returns the number of H3 cells (hexagons and pentagons) at resolution res; mathematically 2 + 120*7^res.
requirements: res must be within the supported resolution range.
out must point to writable memory for one int64_t.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: res0CellCount
functions.description: Returns the number of resolution 0 cells (hexagons and pentagons).

functions.name: getRes0Cells
functions.description: Writes all base (resolution 0) cells into out.
requirements: out must point to a buffer large enough to hold res0CellCount() H3Index values.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: pentagonCount
functions.description: Returns the number of pentagon cells per resolution.

functions.name: getPentagons
functions.description: Generates all pentagon cells at the specified resolution and writes them to out.
requirements: res must be within the supported range.
out must point to a buffer large enough to hold pentagonCount() H3Index values.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: getResolution
functions.description: Returns the resolution of the provided H3 index (valid for both cells and directed edges).
requirements: h must be a valid H3 index for a meaningful result.

functions.name: getBaseCellNumber
functions.description: Returns the base cell number (0–121) of the provided H3 cell; for edges, returns the origin cell’s base cell.
requirements: h should be a valid H3 index.

functions.name: getIndexDigit
functions.signature: H3Error getIndexDigit(H3Index h, int res, int *out)
functions.description: Returns the child digit of index h at resolution res (digits are 1-indexed starting at resolution 1).
requirements: h must be a valid H3 cell index.
res must be within valid range and not exceed h’s resolution.
out must point to writable memory for one int.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: constructCell
functions.signature: H3Error constructCell(int res, int baseCellNumber, const int *digits, H3Index *out)
functions.description: Constructs a valid H3 cell index from its components (resolution, base cell number, and per-resolution digits).
requirements: res and baseCellNumber must be within valid domains for H3.
digits must point to an array with at least res elements containing valid child digits (no deleted digit values).
out must point to writable memory for one H3Index.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: stringToH3
functions.description: Parses a canonical string representation of an H3 index into H3Index form.
requirements: str must point to a null-terminated string in canonical H3 format.
out must point to writable memory for one H3Index.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: h3ToString
functions.signature: H3Error h3ToString(H3Index h, char *str, size_t sz)
functions.description: Converts an H3Index to its canonical string representation, writing into str.
requirements: h must be a valid H3 index.
str must point to a writable buffer of at least sz bytes; sz must be large enough for the canonical string and terminator.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: isValidCell
functions.description: Returns 1 if h is a valid H3 cell (hexagon or pentagon); returns 0 for edges, vertices, or invalid data.
requirements: h can be any H3Index; result indicates validity as a cell.

functions.name: isValidIndex
functions.description: Returns 1 if h is a valid H3 index of any supported type (cell, directed edge, or vertex); 0 otherwise.
requirements: h can be any H3Index; result indicates overall validity.

functions.name: cellToParent
functions.signature: H3Error cellToParent(H3Index h, int parentRes, H3Index *parent)
functions.description: Returns the parent (or ancestor) cell of h at resolution parentRes.
requirements: h must be a valid H3 cell index.
parentRes must be between 0 and the resolution of h (domain errors otherwise).
parent must point to writable memory for one H3Index.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: cellToChildrenSize
functions.signature: H3Error cellToChildrenSize(H3Index h, int childRes, int64_t *out)
functions.description: Determines the exact number of descendant cells at resolution childRes for cell h.
requirements: h must be a valid H3 cell index.
childRes must be >= h’s resolution and within supported range.
out must point to writable memory for one int64_t.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: cellToChildren
functions.signature: H3Error cellToChildren(H3Index h, int childRes, H3Index *children)
functions.description: Writes all descendant cells of h at resolution childRes into children.
requirements: h must be a valid H3 cell index.
childRes must be >= h’s resolution and within supported range.
children must be a buffer of exactly the size reported by cellToChildrenSize(h, childRes, ...).
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: cellToCenterChild
functions.signature: H3Error cellToCenterChild(H3Index h, int childRes, H3Index *child)
functions.description: Returns the center child of cell h at resolution childRes.
requirements: h must be a valid H3 cell index.
childRes must be >= h’s resolution and within supported range.
child must point to writable memory for one H3Index.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: cellToChildPos
functions.signature: H3Error cellToChildPos(H3Index child, int parentRes, int64_t *out)
functions.description: Returns the position of child within the ordered list of all children of its parent at resolution parentRes.
requirements: child must be a valid H3 cell index.
parentRes must be less than or equal to the child’s resolution and within range.
out must point to writable memory for one int64_t.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: childPosToCell
functions.signature: H3Error childPosToCell(int64_t childPos, H3Index parent, int childRes, H3Index *child)
functions.description: Returns the child cell at position childPos among all children of parent at resolution childRes.
requirements: childPos must be within the valid range for the parent/childRes set (domain errors otherwise).
parent must be a valid H3 cell index.
childRes must be > parent’s resolution and within range.
child must point to writable memory for one H3Index.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: compactCells
functions.signature: H3Error compactCells(const H3Index *h3Set, H3Index *compactedSet, const int64_t numHexes)
functions.description: Compacts a set of cells by replacing full child sets with their parent cells where possible.
requirements: h3Set must point to an array of numHexes H3 cell indexes.
numHexes must be non-negative and match the array length.
compactedSet must point to a buffer of numHexes H3Index elements (result may include H3_NULL for unused slots).
Input set should not contain duplicates (E_DUPLICATE_INPUT possible).
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: uncompactCellsSize
functions.signature: H3Error uncompactCellsSize(const H3Index *compactedSet, const int64_t numCompacted, const int res, int64_t *out)
functions.description: Determines the exact number of cells that will result from uncompacting a set to resolution res.
requirements: compactedSet must point to an array of numCompacted H3 indexes (cells).
numCompacted must be non-negative and match array length.
res must be within the supported range and >= resolutions of inputs as required by the library.
out must point to writable memory for one int64_t.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: uncompactCells
functions.signature: H3Error uncompactCells(const H3Index *compactedSet, const int64_t numCompacted, H3Index *outSet, const int64_t numOut, const int res)
functions.description: Expands a compacted set of cells into all constituent cells at resolution res, writing exactly numOut outputs.
requirements: compactedSet must point to an array of numCompacted H3 indexes.
numCompacted must be non-negative.
res must be within supported range and appropriate for inputs.
outSet must point to a buffer with capacity for exactly numOut H3Index values, where numOut must match uncompactCellsSize for the same inputs.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: isResClassIII
functions.description: Returns non-zero if the cell uses Class III orientation at its resolution; zero if Class II.
requirements: h should be a valid H3 cell index.

functions.name: isPentagon
functions.description: Returns non-zero if the H3 cell is a pentagon.
requirements: h should be a valid H3 cell index.

functions.name: maxFaceCount
functions.description: Returns the maximum number of icosahedron faces intersected by the given index (upper bound useful for buffer sizing).
requirements: h3 must be a valid H3 index.
out must point to writable memory for one int.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: getIcosahedronFaces
functions.description: Writes all icosahedron face numbers intersected by the given H3 index into out.
requirements: h3 must be a valid H3 index.
out must reference a buffer large enough to hold up to the count given by maxFaceCount(h3, ...).
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: areNeighborCells
functions.signature: H3Error areNeighborCells(H3Index origin, H3Index destination, int *out)
functions.description: Sets out to non-zero if the two cells share a common edge (are neighbors), zero otherwise.
requirements: origin and destination must be valid H3 cell indexes.
out must point to writable memory for one int.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: cellsToDirectedEdge
functions.signature: H3Error cellsToDirectedEdge(H3Index origin, H3Index destination, H3Index *out)
functions.description: Returns the directed edge index from origin to destination, if the cells are neighboring.
requirements: origin and destination must be valid neighboring H3 cell indexes (E_NOT_NEIGHBORS otherwise).
out must point to writable memory for one H3Index.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: isValidDirectedEdge
functions.description: Returns non-zero if edge is a valid H3 directed edge index.
requirements: edge can be any H3Index; result indicates validity as a directed edge.

functions.name: getDirectedEdgeOrigin
functions.description: Extracts the origin cell index from a directed edge index.
requirements: edge must be a valid H3 directed edge index.
out must point to writable memory for one H3Index.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: getDirectedEdgeDestination
functions.description: Extracts the destination cell index from a directed edge index.
requirements: edge must be a valid H3 directed edge index.
out must point to writable memory for one H3Index.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: directedEdgeToCells
functions.description: Writes the origin and destination cell indexes corresponding to the directed edge index into originDestination[0..1].
requirements: edge must be a valid H3 directed edge index.
originDestination must point to a buffer for 2 H3Index values.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: originToDirectedEdges
functions.description: Writes all directed edges originating from the given cell (6 for hexagons, 5 for pentagons).
requirements: origin must be a valid H3 cell index.
edges must point to a buffer for 6 H3Index values (sufficient for hexagons; pentagons use 5).
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: directedEdgeToBoundary
functions.description: Returns the geographic boundary (as two vertices) of the given directed edge.
requirements: edge must be a valid H3 directed edge index.
gb must point to writable memory for one CellBoundary.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: reverseDirectedEdge
functions.description: Returns the directed edge index with origin and destination reversed.
requirements: edge must be a valid H3 directed edge index.
out must point to writable memory for one H3Index.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: cellToVertex
functions.signature: H3Error cellToVertex(H3Index origin, int vertexNum, H3Index *out)
functions.description: Returns the vertex index corresponding to vertexNum of the given cell.
requirements: origin must be a valid H3 cell index.
vertexNum must be within the valid vertex range for the cell (domain errors otherwise).
out must point to writable memory for one H3Index.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: cellToVertexes
functions.description: Returns all vertex indexes for the given cell.
requirements: origin must be a valid H3 cell index.
vertexes must point to a buffer large enough to hold all vertices (6 for hexagons, 5 for pentagons).
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: vertexToLatLng
functions.description: Returns the geographic coordinate (radians) of the given vertex index.
requirements: vertex must be a valid H3 vertex index.
point must point to writable memory for one LatLng.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: isValidVertex
functions.description: Returns non-zero if the input is a valid H3 vertex index.
requirements: vertex can be any H3Index; result indicates validity as a vertex.

functions.name: gridDistance
functions.signature: H3Error gridDistance(H3Index origin, H3Index h3, int64_t *distance)
functions.description: Computes the grid distance (in hex steps) between two indexes, when defined.
requirements: origin and h3 must be valid H3 cell indexes at the same resolution (E_RES_MISMATCH/other errors otherwise).
distance must point to writable memory for one int64_t.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: gridPathCellsSize
functions.signature: H3Error gridPathCellsSize(H3Index start, H3Index end, int64_t *size)
functions.description: Returns the number of indexes in a grid path (line) between start and end, for buffer sizing.
requirements: start and end must be valid H3 cell indexes at the same resolution.
size must point to writable memory for one int64_t.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: gridPathCells
functions.signature: H3Error gridPathCells(H3Index start, H3Index end, H3Index *out)
functions.description: Writes the sequence of cell indexes forming a grid path between start and end.
requirements: start and end must be valid H3 cell indexes at the same resolution.
out must point to a buffer with capacity equal to gridPathCellsSize(start, end, ...).
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: cellToLocalIj
functions.signature: H3Error cellToLocalIj(H3Index origin, H3Index h3, uint32_t mode, CoordIJ *out)
functions.description: Converts a cell index to local IJ coordinates in the coordinate system defined by origin.
requirements: origin and h3 must be valid H3 cell indexes at the same resolution.
mode must be a valid mode/flags value (E_OPTION_INVALID on invalid).
out must point to writable memory for one CoordIJ.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.

functions.name: localIjToCell
functions.signature: H3Error localIjToCell(H3Index origin, const CoordIJ *ij, uint32_t mode, H3Index *out)
functions.description: Converts local IJ coordinates (relative to origin) back to a cell index.
requirements: origin must be a valid H3 cell index.
ij must point to a valid CoordIJ.
mode must be a valid mode/flags value (E_OPTION_INVALID on invalid).
out must point to writable memory for one H3Index.
Caller must check the H3Error return value.
